name: Selby Electric
old_description: Selby Electric specializes in residential and commercial electrical services. Whether you need a small electrical wiring fix, have an issue that needs troubleshooting, or installation of state-of-the-art smart home technology, Selby Electric will get the job done right. Looking for a reliable electrician around Bismarck or Mandan? You’ve found me!
about:
Selby Electric operates from Mandan, North Dakota, serving Bismarck, Mandan, and the surrounding Burleigh and Morton counties. The business was established by Craig Selby, a North Dakota Master Electrician (license #M4002), who has accumulated over 30 years of hands-on experience in residential and commercial electrical work. Selby runs the company as a sole proprietorship, handling every job personally without subcontractors.

The company provides a full range of electrical services, including recessed lighting installation, ceiling fan wiring and replacement, electrical panel upgrades to meet current code, preventive maintenance inspections, wiring and repair for outlets and full rewires, shop wiring for 240‑volt outlets and sub‑panels, troubleshooting of tripping breakers and flickering lights, electrical work for room additions and remodel projects, and code‑compliant EV charger installations. All work is performed by Selby himself, ensuring consistent quality and direct communication.

Selby Electric serves both residential homeowners and commercial clients across the Bismarck‑Mandan area. Commercial projects have included wiring for shops, offices, and other local businesses, with Selby present on each job site to coordinate with contractors and keep projects on schedule.

Selby emphasizes that his local ownership means he is invested in the community and builds long‑term relationships with customers who rely on him to keep their homes and businesses safe. His differentiators are direct owner involvement on every project, clear communication, and a commitment to completing work correctly the first time.
